name: read_file
description: Read a line-numbered excerpt from a local file (regular files only). use_line_numbers=false returns raw content without line prefixes (e.g. for copy into apply_patch).

file_path.description: Path to a regular file, absolute or relative to the effective working directory (directories unsupported; some sensitive paths are blocked).

char_offset.description: 0-based char offset within the first selected line; use the continuation value returned when a long line is truncated.

limit.description: Number of lines to read (default: 1000). Large limit for an overview, small (20-40) for a precise slice. Very large results are capped; a truncation notice gives the continuation offset.

use_line_numbers.description: Prefix each line with its 1-based line number (default: true). false returns raw content; offset/limit paging and the truncation notice still apply.
